en.io: Inputs are environment-resolved vault paths, .aigent state markers, and Markdown or JSON memory records. Outputs are a brief session orientation, refreshed runtime state, and in limited recovery cases an updated session log.
en.boundary: The protocol applies only to a preconfigured aigent-OS vault and must stop if validation fails. Most operations are reads, but recovery and runtime refresh can write or execute a daemon; the contents and behavior of referenced scripts and auxiliary skills are not included in the evidence.
scenarios: Validate that AIGENT_ROOT or AIGENT_VAULT resolves to a configured vault.
Route an unready installation to first-run setup.
Recover a newer unbanked session capture into the session log.
Read prioritized memory, daily notes, delegation state, decisions, and runtime state.
Trigger periodic skill-gap or weekly reconciliation checks when due.

zh.io: 输入为通过环境变量解析的 vault 路径、.aigent 状态标记以及 Markdown 或 JSON 记忆记录；输出为简短会话导向、刷新的运行时状态，并在有限恢复场景中更新会话日志。
zh.boundary: 该协议仅适用于已配置的 aigent-OS vault，验证失败必须停止。多数操作为读取，但恢复和运行时刷新可能写入或执行守护脚本；所引用脚本及辅助技能的实际内容未包含在证据中。
dependencies: 已有 vault/memory 与 vault/daily 目录
被引用的 /start、/skill-hunt 和 /reconcile 能力
文档规定的 vault 记忆文件
scenarios: 验证 AIGENT_ROOT 或 AIGENT_VAULT 是否指向已配置 vault。
将未就绪安装引导至首次运行设置。
将更新的未归档会话捕获恢复到会话日志。
读取高优先级记忆、每日记录、委派状态、决策和运行时状态。
到期时触发技能缺口或每周对账检查。
